name: zmodel_const_solve_tri_scalar_gradient_2d
description: zModel_Const::SolveTriScalarGradient2D solves the two-component gradient of a scalar value over a projected triangle and returns zero for degenerate projected geometry.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers analytic non-degenerate gradients and the degenerate determinant path. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel AddPolygonEx source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x484860 validates a stack-argument helper taking projected triangle coordinates and scalar values, returning a zClipUV pair in eax/edx, and callee-cleaning 36 argument bytes.
Binary Ninja assembly validates a determinant-zero path returning {0, 0} and a non-degenerate path returning the two scalar-gradient coefficients.
The native smoke verifies unit gradients for scalar fields f(a,b)=a and f(a,b)=b on a right triangle, plus the degenerate projected-triangle zero result.
